payload.summary: Statutory SDRF fund estimate ₹217,500.00 for odisha_cuttack

payload.comments: Damage and SDRF schedule verified against aerial computer vision. Authorized for initial tranche release.

line_items.unit_description: Agricultural input subsidy for crop loss (>33% damage, rainfed)
line_items.mha_norm_reference: MHA SDRF Item 5 - Agriculture input subsidy

line_items.unit_description: Loss of clothing and household utensils per affected family

action_payload.plain_language_explanation: Relief estimate of ₹217,500.00 (0.0217 Crores) is strictly grounded in Ministry of Home Affairs statutory SDRF schedules. It accounts for 1 verified damaged housing structures detected via aerial computer vision, 25.0 hectares of inundated agricultural cropland, and immediate subsistence assistance for 1 displaced families.
audit_notes: All unit rates reflect official Government of India SDRF/NDRF Gazette notifications.
No black-box ML weights were used for currency valuation; values are deterministic.
Requires physical on-ground verification by District Revenue Officer before disbursement.
